2607.13602.title: Analogical Deep Research: Retrieving and Integrating Historical Analogies for Foresight Analysis
2607.13602.paper_summary: Systematic comparisons between current situations and structurally similar past events in the historical, i.e., historical analogies, is among the most powerful tools for foresight analysis. In this work, we present a new task called Analogical Deep Research (ADR) to Large Language Model (LLM) agents and construct the first ADR benchmark ADR-bench to study whether LLM agents are able to find and leverage historical analogies when doing foresight analysis. Our investigation reveals a key obstacle: LLM agents are poor at finding analogies because they match on surface features rather than underlying mechanisms. We argue that ADR is inherently a causal question as it requires understanding why the event occurred. Based on our theoretical analysis, we propose two principles required for ADR, including the mechanism alignment and cross-analogy confirmation. Built upon our theoretical results, we propose a new agentic framework called Causal Analogical Researcher (CANA) that guides LLMs to find and integrate historical analogies. CANA incorporates a simple yet effective structural decomposition representation, and integrates structural feedback for reflective improvements of historical analogy identification and integration. We show that CANA brings up to 10% improvements in historical analogy generation, and surpasses the state-of-the-art deep research agents in the ADR-bench. Case studies with the ongoing events confirm the effectiveness of CANA in leveraging historical analogies.
2607.13602.paper_summary_zh: 系統性比較當前情況與歷史上結構相似的事件，即歷史類比，是前瞻分析中最強大的工具之一。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們提出了一個新的任務，稱為類比深度研究（ADR），針對大型語言模型（LLM）代理，並構建了第一個ADR基準ADR-bench，以研究LLM代理在進行前瞻分析時是否能夠找到並利用歷史類比。<lb/>我們的調查揭示了一個關鍵障礙：LLM代理在尋找類比方面表現不佳，因為它們是基於表面特徵而非潛在機制進行匹配。<lb/>我們認為ADR本質上是一個因果問題，因為它需要理解事件發生的原因。<lb/>基於我們的理論分析，我們提出了ADR所需的兩個原則，包括機制對齊和跨類比確認。<lb/>基於我們的理論結果，我們提出了一個新的代理框架，稱為因果類比研究者（CANA），該框架指導LLM找到並整合歷史類比。<lb/>CANA包含一種簡單而有效的結構分解表示，並整合結構反饋以反思性地改進歷史類比的識別和整合。<lb/>我們顯示CANA在歷史類比生成上帶來了高達10%的改進，並在ADR-bench中超越了最先進的深度研究代理。<lb/>針對當前事件的案例研究證實了CANA在利用歷史類比方面的有效性。
